description: This file defines an abstract class 'CompatTab' representing a single tab in an Android tabbed interface. It includes abstract methods for setting and getting tab properties such as text, icon, fragment, and callback, and stores references to the associated activity and tag.

classes.name: CompatTab
classes.description: An abstract class representing a user interface tab with methods to set and retrieve its properties.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text of the tab.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon of the tab.

methods.name: setTabListener
methods.description: Sets the callback listener for tab events.

methods.name: setFragment
methods.description: Associates a fragment with the tab.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves the text associated with the tab.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Retrieves the icon associated with the tab.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Retrieves the fragment associated with the tab.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag identifier for the tab.
